prose: Simon Willison welcomes EmbeddingGemma 2 being released under Apache 2.0. For embedding models, he argues, closed hosted-only models are a poor fit because applications store millions of vectors, and if the vendor retires the model you must pay to recompute them. He wants a hosted option with the fallback of running open weights himself or switching vendor.
highlights: Apache 2.0 licence is the point for him.
Wants a hosted option with an open-weight fallback.
